2.body: Habari team 👋 Please ensure you do your testing using your OWN personal link ending in ?who= followed by a long code. This page contains all five testing parts and also shows when an app is updated and needs retesting. Please do NOT use the old Testers’ List page, as it only has the video and steps. If you can’t find your personal link, kindly reach out to me for a resend. Asante sana!
Habari team , start with Ahead of it this morning. Happy testing 👏
